 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Tom Brady showed his support for Fox Sports colleague Erin Andrews ahead of her career milestone with the network.
 Ahead of the marquee matchup between the New England Patriots and the Green Bay Packers at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, NFL on Fox announced Andrews' major career feat.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The veteran sportscaster, who joined Fox Sports in 2012, will work her 300th NFL broadcast on Sunday.
 "Congratulations to our very own @erinandrews, who marks an incredible milestone of 300 NFL broadcasts this Sunday! @foxsports," the post's caption read.
 Brady was among those who reacted to the announcement. The NFL legend had a three-emoji reaction to Andrews' incredible feat.
 "❤️❤️❤️," Brady wrote in the comments section.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Andrews has been working with the Fox Sports top NFL crew as a sideline reporter opposite Tom Rinaldi. Brady serves as the NFL analyst in the booth alongside play-by-play announcer Kevin Burkhardt.
 Apart from being one of the top reporters in the NFL, Andrews has also expanded her personal brand outside of football. She runs a very successful fan apparel business, WEAR by Erin Andrews. The 48-year-old also hosts a long-running podcast titled "Calm Down" with fellow Fox Sports reporter and good friend Charissa Thompson.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sunday's game also carries extra significance for Brady. He will call a game at Foxborough for the first time since he transitioned to broadcasting.
 He'll be returning to the stadium where he spent most of his legendary football career with the New England Patriots, winning six Super Bowls. This time, however, he will be in the booth.
